title: Negative control for the x-authority gate: a length bound
description: A bare minLength with no adjacent x-authority. A minLength is nearly always structural, which is the argument for exempting it and the reason not to: the exemption would also cover the sourced length — a localization key length, an ID length taken from a document — that most needs attributing. This file proves the gate can fail. It is never loaded as a real schema.
